reasons.text: The claimed purchase date of 2022-03-17 is before the program's sale window, which opens 2022-09-01. Purchases before the window are not eligible.
The label photo is legible and shows model 2G505B, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed. This does not change the outcome, since the purchase date is the deciding factor.
The retailer, Esrtech.com, is on the list of sellers, so the retailer itself is not a problem.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.
The destruction photo does not show the word 'Recalled' written in permanent marker; it shows a printed word on the device. This would also require a new photo if the claim were otherwise eligible.
